      (x0 OR NOT x1 OR x2)
      (NOT x0 OR x2 OR x3)
      (NOT x0 OR x1 OR NOT x3)
      (x0 OR NOT x2 OR NOT x3)

    x0, x1, x2, x3 = problem_qubits
    a0, a1, a2, a3, a4 = ancilla_qubits

    # Clause 1: (x0 OR NOT x1 OR x2)
    # Compute NOT x1 into a0: a0 = x1 (then we'll flip later)
    qc.cx(x1, a0)          # a0 = x1
    qc.x(a0)               # a0 = NOT x1
    # Now compute clause: a0 = (x0 OR NOT x1 OR x2) = NOT( (NOT x0) AND x1 AND (NOT x2) )
    # We'll use multi-controlled X to check if all literals are false
    # Literals false when: x0=0, x1=1, x2=0
    # So we need to check: x0=0, x1=1, x2=0

    qc.x(x2)               # flip x2 to check for 0

    qc.x(x2)               # restore
    qc.x(a1)               # a1 = NOT (all false) = clause satisfied

    # Uncompute a0

    qc.cx(x1, a0)

    qc.x(x0)               # restore
    qc.x(a2)               # a2 = clause satisfied

    qc.x(x0)               # flip x0 for NOT x0
    qc.x(x3)               # flip x3 for NOT x3
    qc.mcx([x0, x1, x3], a3)  # a3 = 1 iff x0=0, x1=0, x3=1 (all false)

    qc.x(x3)               # restore
    qc.x(a3)               # a3 = clause satisfied

    qc.x(x3)               # flip x3 for NOT x3
